name: Reload
description: If this unit neither acts nor takes damage for a full round, every one of its ability cooldowns is refreshed at the start of its next turn.
details: Damage a barrier absorbs entirely does not interrupt it.

upgrade.summary: Abilities may be cast without interrupting the reload.
details: Damage a barrier absorbs entirely does not interrupt it.
Casting abilities no longer breaks the reload - only attacking, walking, or taking damage does.
Being moved by something else, a translocation or a pull, is not walking and does not count.
